Tests individually reject each shell metacharacter: |, ;, >, <

user_stories.title: Implement ValidateCwdTests with 8 path traversal tests
acceptance_criteria: 8 tests pass for validate_cwd() function
Tests accept None as valid input
Tests accept paths within SAFE_CWD_ROOTS (including nested subdirectories)

user_stories.notes: Critical path traversal prevention. Uses real temp directories instead of mocks because is_within() uses Path.resolve(strict=True) which has real filesystem behavior.
